speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Reach Surya. Secure the heat works, disable the gun deck, and breach the inner curtain.

speaker: SURYA
text: Stone can fall and still be rebuilt. The wall will fall, and the people behind it will remain.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Surya Prime has joined. His Solar Bulwark absorbs heat and incoming fire, enough to cross the superheated corridors.

speaker: SURYA
text: Wait for the vents to flare. Bulwark through, then recover on the far platform.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Coolant line ahead. I can shut these guns down without burning the district.

speaker: TITAN
text: Maintenance wall. Give me room, and we have another way through.

speaker: AURA
text: Their command channel is still local. I can break its hold on the gate.

speaker: VOSS
text: You have reached the wall. You have not earned the right to cross it.

speaker: VOSS
text: Seal the arena. Bring the inner defenses online.

speaker: VOSS
text: All power to weapons. Hold this line!

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Voss is down. An extraction route is available.

speaker: KAITO
text: Open the crossing first. We leave when they can.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Stay together. There is room for everyone.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Crossing secured. Updating the mission: bring them home.
